run.change_description: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Make Content-Type media-type matching case-insensitive in parseBody() and validator() while keeping parameters such as multipart boundaries intact (issue #5060).
summary.issue_fit: Partial — the mixed-case JSON, urlencoded and multipart cases from #5060 are handled, but the parseFormData() rewrite breaks calling c.req.formData() before c.req.parseBody().
summary.coverage: All six changed files and the full merge-base diff reviewed; callers in src/request.ts and src/validator/validator.ts read; focused vitest run and a base-versus-head probe executed. The clone has an untracked .mcp.json outside the range, not reviewed.
check_details: Reviewer ran vitest (main project, coverage off) on body, buffer, validator and request tests at the reviewed head: 144 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0. No test covers c.req.formData() followed by c.req.parseBody().
Reviewer ran a scratch base-versus-head probe at both heads: the formData-then-parseBody sequence fails at head and passes at base.
Supplied codecov and benchmark comments (head 5226d41) were not reused: raw output unavailable and neither settles the finding.

findings.title: Reuse cached FormData in parseFormData
findings.trigger: A handler or middleware awaits `c.req.formData()` and then `c.req.parseBody()` on the same request.
findings.impact: parseFormData() now calls `arrayBuffer()`, which re-serializes the cached FormData with a new boundary; multipart requests reject with `Failed to parse body as FormData.`, and urlencoded requests silently return a single garbage key instead of the fields. Base returned the cached FormData and worked for both.
findings.change: In `parseFormData`, when `request instanceof HonoRequest && request.bodyCache.formData` is set, await it and convert it directly, as `src/validator/validator.ts` does, keeping the `arrayBuffer()`/`bufferToFormData()` path for the uncached case, and add a regression test for `formData()` followed by `parseBody()`.
findings.source: Base behavior of `parseFormData` through `HonoRequest.formData()` in `src/request.ts`; issue #5060 scopes the change to media-type matching.

observations.fact: On Node 24 the platform Request.formData() already accepts mixed-case multipart and urlencoded media types, so the parseBody() guard change alone covers the reported Node case; the parseFormData() rewrite matters only where a runtime's native parser is case-sensitive, which was not checked.
observations.evidence: scratch probe `clone-work/native.mjs` (both cases parsed under Node v24.21.0), `src/utils/body.ts:121-133`.

observations.fact: parseBody() now requires an exact media type, so prefix-only values such as `multipart/form-data-x` that base's startsWith accepted are no longer parsed.

requirements.evidence: src/utils/body.ts:100-104 lower-cases the media type before matching; src/validator/validator.ts:24-26 regexes gain the i flag; src/utils/buffer.ts:113 lower-cases only text before the first semicolon
src/utils/body.test.ts, src/validator/validator.test.ts and src/utils/buffer.test.ts add mixed-case urlencoded, multipart and JSON cases; all pass at head
Mixed-case bodies are parsed, but parseFormData now fails or returns garbage after c.req.formData() (finding src/utils/body/parseFormData-ignores-formdata-cache)
